name: Name:
name-tooltip: The folder name shown throughout FolderView Plus.
icon-tooltip: Choose an icon from Built-in icons, Icon Packs, or My uploads, or enter an image URL or path. You can also use a container or VM icon from the member list.
preview-tooltip: Choose how members appear in the collapsed folder row: icons and labels, icons only, labels only, or a list. None hides the member preview.
preview-hover-tooltip: Show the collapsed member preview only while the pointer is over the folder row. In touch mode, the preview remains visible without hovering.
preview-update-tooltip: Show a container name in orange in the member preview when that container has an update available. The folder title has a separate highlight setting.
preview-grayscale-tooltip: Display all member preview icons in grayscale.
preview-webui-tooltip: Add a button to each container preview that opens that container's WebUI, when available.
preview-logs-tooltip: Add a button to each container or VM preview that opens that member's logs, when available.
preview-console-tooltip: Add a button to each container preview that opens that container's console.
preview-vertical-bars-tooltip: Show vertical dividers between container or VM previews.
context-tooltip: Choose what opens from a container preview: None disables the popup, Default opens the Unraid container menu, and Advanced opens a popup with container details and actions.
context-trigger-tooltip: Open the Advanced preview popup by clicking or hovering over a container preview. Touch mode always uses a tap.
context-graph-tooltip: Choose which usage graphs appear in the Advanced preview popup: Combined shows CPU and memory together, Split shows separate graphs, CPU only or MEM only shows one metric, and None hides the graphs.
context-graph-time-tooltip: Set how many seconds of usage history the Advanced preview graphs display. This does not change the refresh interval.
border-tooltip: Show a border around the folder's member preview area.
border-color-tooltip: Choose the preview border color and width from 1 to 4 pixels. The reset button restores the default border color and a width of 1 pixel.
bars-color-tooltip: Choose the vertical divider color and width from 1 to 4 pixels. The reset button uses the current theme text color and restores a width of 1 pixel.
update-column-tooltip: Hide the update summary cell on this Docker folder's row.
expand-tab-tooltip: Default to expanded on the Docker or VM tab when this folder has no saved expansion state on that view. A remembered state takes priority.
expand-dashboard-tooltip: Default to expanded on the Dashboard when this folder has no saved Dashboard expansion state. A remembered state takes priority.
regex-tooltip: Legacy compatibility rule that automatically includes matching container or VM names. Editing it preserves manually selected members. Use managed Rules for new automation; this field is available for repairing older rules.
order-tooltip: Use the up and down buttons to order folder members. Automatically included regex matches are locked in the Included column. Editing the regex preserves manual selections.
custom-actions-folder-tooltip: Add actions to this folder's menu. Standard actions control containers or VMs chosen from the member selector: Toggle state switches between start/stop or pause/resume, Set state applies one state, and Restart restarts them. User Script actions require the User Scripts plugin; enter the exact case-sensitive script name, including any spaces, and optional arguments. Wait for completion keeps the script in the foreground; otherwise it runs in the background. Leave the icon class blank to use the default. Use the list to edit, remove, or reorder actions.
custom-action: Add a custom action
custom-action-tooltip: Open the action editor to create a new folder menu action. Adding an action does not run it.
default-action-tooltip: Hide the built-in member controls, such as start, stop, and restart, from this folder's menu.
preview-text-width-tooltip: Set the width of container or VM names in the preview using a CSS length, such as 12rem or 120px. Leave blank to use automatic sizing.
override-default-actions-tooltip: Replace the built-in member controls with this folder's custom actions when at least one custom action exists. Folder management entries remain available.
folder-webui-tooltip: Add a WebUI entry to this Docker folder's menu using the URL specified below.
folder-webui-url-tooltip: The URL to open when clicking the WebUI button in the folder context menu.
folderviewplus-desc: FolderView Plus adds folder-based organization to Unraid Docker, VM, and Dashboard views with nested folders, the Setup Assistant, smart rules, bulk assignment, reusable templates, recovery tools, and copyable diagnostics.
preview-overflow-tooltip: Choose whether extra preview members follow the row limit, expand the folder row, or remain in a single horizontally scrollable row.
preview-row-separators-tooltip: Add a horizontal separator between compact preview rows.
folder-update-highlight: Orange folder name on member update:
folder-update-highlight-tooltip: Highlight the folder title separately when at least one Docker member has an update available.
status-color-lock-tooltip: Give this folder's selected status colors priority over theme styles. Theme default text remains automatic unless you choose a custom text color.
folderviewplus-dev-desc: FolderView Plus development builds are for testing. Expect bugs, regressions, and unfinished changes before stable release.
folderviewplus-dev-quickstart: Development branch: test changes before stable release. Update carefully and expect occasional breakage.
folderviewplus-quickstart: Quick start: open Settings → FolderView Plus. Use Basic for everyday folder management and Advanced for bulk assignment, rules, recovery, operations, and diagnostics. Changes save automatically.
